answer: One artifact per identity: a tundra ice core, violet-sealed on site, filed in the bridge registry with its assay fingerprint. The bridge ledger rejects any fingerprint on file; a second filing burns both bonds. First filing costs 40, the kth 40+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000, lock 70,000 more, against a 40,000 pool. A rented tundra core fails: the lender's violet seal breaks on filing. An honest agent files once, pays 40, keeps its bond.
